neighbours.label: In English text that defines a network, graph, data structure, map or model, the linking word right after an element noun that says what each element is or stands for ('the nodes are ...', 'each X represents ...', 'every dot stands for ...'). Quiet: the same element nouns described without a mapping (their colour, position or state), symbolism in stories and poems, a person representing a client or country. Elected members representing districts can also light up partly.
fire: In this graph, the nodes represent cities and the edges represent direct flights between them.
Each vertex stands for a user account, and an edge connects two users who follow each other.
On the map, every red dot stands for a weather station that reported data last year.
In the neural network diagram, each circle represents a single neuron in the hidden layer.
The rows of the adjacency matrix correspond to source nodes, and each entry indicates whether a link exists.
In our model, each agent represents a household deciding how much water to use.
Here the leaves of the tree are the individual words, and each internal node denotes a phrase.
Every square on the grid stands for one hectare of farmland in the simulation.
quiet: In this graph, the nodes are drawn in blue and the edges are slightly thicker than usual.
The vertex in the upper left corner has turned red after the last update.
On the map, the red dots are clustered near the coast and fade toward the mountains.
In the neural network diagram, the circles in the hidden layer are arranged in two neat columns.
The adjacency matrix was printed on three pages because it was too wide for one.
In the novel, the green light across the bay represents Gatsby's longing for the future.
In her poem, the falling leaves stand for the passing of youth.
The lawyer represents a small bakery in its dispute with the landlord.

predictions: Expect most fire sentences 0.3-0.7 on the mapping verb; near misses mostly below 0.15. Risk: 'nodes are drawn in blue' may leak on ' are' in a graph frame.
